description: Department of Local Government North Central Province -  Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2086/15 of 29.08.2018
categorisation: This gazette content deals with revisions to allowances and expenses for municipal council members (Mayors, Deputy Mayors) and Pradeshiya Sabha members (Chairman, members), including refreshment allowances and meeting participation expenses. It also covers allowances for personal staff of the Chairman. These are public service administrative matters related to service conditions, benefits, and allowances for local government officials, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8). While it mentions government positions, it does not involve structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would classify it under government-related types (1-3).
